name: Common Lodge
tagline: A café-inspired container hall for shared meals, work and gathering.
description: Three reused 40-foot containers frame a large timber-framed gathering hall. The north wing holds the shared kitchen, pantry, laundry and accessible washrooms; the central hall is the shared dining and gathering space; the south wing holds the workshop, meeting room and boot room; the west wing holds the café servery, office and a universal washroom. Insulated sliding/folding glazing and a screened veranda connect the hall to the forest. The existing authoritative lodge model is preserved separately; this is an additional Design Lab concept.
